item.title: 【Live Audios (lossy)】MP3 - Katy Perry - The Lifetimes Tour Finale - Japan 2025 (IEM)
item.description:
Katy Perry - The Lifetimes Tour Finale - Japan 2025 (IEM)

Multi-Stereo IEM Matrix Recording

"Princess of Pop" Katy Perry's long-awaited Japan tour arrives with official, premium sound! This one-night-only performance at Saitama Super Arena on December 3, 2025, is fully captured in multi-stereo IEM matrix recording by the renowned XAVEL label. The multiple IEM sources used by each band member onstage, each with a different mix balance, are perfectly balanced in stereo. This soulful live performance, concluding the latest "The Lifetimes Tour," has been captured in stunning high-quality sound comparable to a stereo soundboard recording, making this a must-have commemorative item for all fans. The clicks and guides often associated with IEM recordings are barely noticeable, ensuring a stress-free experience. Also included is a spectacular original video of the entire live performance, captured with an exceptionally stable audience camera. The bonus footage features a different mix of the multi-stereo IEM sound source also used on the CD, so enjoy the spectacular 5+1-stage stage performance with the best sound and video.
